create.title: Exact t=1 squarefree coefficient and fixed-order conductor-four Voronoi reduction
create.statement_tex: Let R=X^(1/4), N=floor(X), and C(s)=sum_(de=s,e odd,e>4d)chi_4(e). For squarefree s=2^nu n, nu in {0,1}, n odd, C(2^nu n)=sum_(e|n,e>2^(1+nu/2)sqrt(n))chi_4(e), with the complete positive-total-character sector and mandatory antisymmetric negative-total-character tail both retained. A sqrt(D) cone collar is target-safe; after a local d-asymp-D Mellin partition the exact smooth orders are z=i(tau+t/2), with radial twist s^(-it/2), external D^(it)4^(-i tau), bandwidth |tau|<<D^(1/2)X^epsilon, and the hard Perron zero residue retained. Put A_z(n)=sum_(de=n)chi_4(e)(e/d)^z and B_z(n)=mu^2(n)A_z(n). Then B_z=h_z*A_z and sum A_z(n)n^(-w)=zeta(w+z)L(w-z,chi_4). The exact H_2 and odd H_p factors give powerful support. Moreover H=K/[zeta(2w+2z)zeta(2w-2z)L(2w,chi_4)], with K absolutely convergent for Re w>(1+|Re z|)/3 by the exact mixed-monomial local identity. For every fixed |Re z|<1/4 and compact-smooth F, the conductor-four transform has scalar pi*4^z, one polar term, reflected coefficient A_(-z), and all J/Y/K branches at 2pi sqrt(mx). For K_F=floor(sup supp F), the exact physical H convolution is finite in k<=K_F; every k>K_F polar-dual pair cancels for that same k. Fixed-order resonance occurs at m=kN+O(k sqrt(N/M)), with raw one-term size M^(3/4)/(kR). No growing-order, moving-prefix, signed-correlation, t=1 target, or strict top-range estimate is included.

create.title: Squarefree H-convolution resonance, reciprocal-zero, and all-scale absolute-aggregation obstruction
create.statement_tex: On the exact unitary ratio line, grant optimistically the missing uniform Bessel analysis. For fixed powerful k the best primal/dual physical menu is min(M^(1/4)/k,R/sqrt(M)). Summing its modulus over the physical powerful indices k<=K_F gives M^(1/4+epsilon) for M<=R^(4/3) and R^(1/2+epsilon)M^(-1/8) for R^(4/3)<=M<=R^2, losing R^(1/3) at M=R^(4/3) and R^(1/4) at M=R^2. This is an upper-capacity limitation, not a signed lower bound. The refactor H=K/[zeta(2w+2z)zeta(2w-2z)L(2w,chi_4)] does not license a residue-free shift through possible reciprocal-factor zero poles. The bare lemma sum_(q asymp Q)|sum_(d asymp D)e(Nd/q)|<<_(epsilon)(Q+D)(NQ)^epsilon holds for Q<=N/4, but expanding mu^2(d) and using triangle gives only QD^(1/2)+D before the other squarefree, coprime, parity, character, cone, and prefix conditions. Thus fixed-channel Voronoi plus modulus, absolute powerful-index aggregation, an unowned reciprocal-factor contour shift, and the literal Mobius-square triangle do not prove the t=1 target. The first surviving arithmetic input is joint signed cancellation of h_z(k)A_(-z)(kN+j), |j|<<k sqrt(N/M), k<=K_F, over the actual cone orders, or an equivalent squarefree/coprime strengthening of the bare reciprocal lemma.
